> The onboarding wizard (CO-1). The full chain, in the order branches.routes.ts established: requireTenant -> authenticate -> requireAuth -> authorize -> validate -> handler SINGULAR, LIKE `organization.routes.ts`, AND FOR THE SAME REASON There is no `:organizationId` in any path. Which clinic this is was settled by `resolveTenant` from the Host header before a credential was read; accepting an id would put a second, contradictable answer on the request. A BRANCH id does travel — in the body of steps 2, 3 and 4 — and is checked against `ctx.branchIds` in the service, answering 404 for one the caller cannot see. EVERY STEP IS `PUT`, AND THE VERB IS LOAD-BEARING Re-entering a step in year two —…
